thread:
maya: heads up — noticed spike of 5xx auth errors tied to role_backfill job #452. dashboard shows failures concentrated on shard 7. pausing the job for now.
jonathan: running quick query to confirm. `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role_assignments WHERE role IS NULL AND shard_id = 7;`
kevin: I also spotted KMS errors around the same window earlier, looks like decrypt failures during the job's crypto step.
maya: error snippet from logs: 
```
ERROR role_backfill: failed to decrypt seed_manifest for sa:service-account-123
InvalidCiphertextException: keyMetadata mismatch for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-efgh
at kms_client.decrypt(...)
```
alice: if default_role wasn't applied, some internal services fallback to `readonly` which explains the write failures. could be a race between serviceaccount creation + backfill.
jonathan: query result: 132 rows with null role in shard 7. timestamps of those rows are between 2026-03-15T02:00:12Z and 2026-03-15T02:09:58Z — matches deploy window.
maya: suggested plan: 1) pause global backfill 2) run one-off reconciliation on shard 7 only 3) patch backfill to retry on KMS decrypt failures instead of skipping 4) re-run in small batches as canary.
kevin: agree. added note — KMS key rotation last week might have left some objects wrapped with old key metadata. we should rewrap those blobs or use fallback alias. i'll check alias mappings.
jonathan: i've prepared a patch that adds up to 3 retries with exponential backoff for Decrypt calls and marks items for manual rewrap if retry fails. also added pre-check to ensure target service account is active before assigning. will open PR.
kevin: one-off command to rewrap and reapply (manual):
```
kubectl exec -it job/role-backfill-worker-0 -- /bin/sh -c '
python scripts/rewrap_and_apply.py --shard 7 --filter "role IS NULL" --kms-alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/rlw-legacy'
```
use a dry-run first.
audit-bot: audit: role_backfill job 452 attempted updates on 132 objects; 46 failed with KMS InvalidCiphertextException; job auto-paused at 2167890123.
alice: also need to update the RBAC migration playbook and compliance runbook to include KMS rewrap guidance + how to run shard-scoped reconciliation. i'll draft the doc changes.
maya: ACTIONS: pause job (done), @kevin verify alias & run rewrap dry-run, @jonathan open PR + patch rollout plan, @alice update playbook, then small canary re-run limited to 5k objects. monitor metrics for 1h.
kevin: alias mapping looks off for the old key; scheduling rewrap script now (dry-run). will report output in 10m. :working_on_it: 
jonathan: opened PR #8242 with retry logic and unit tests, request review from eng-security and eng-runtime.
maya: once kevin confirms rewrap dry-run success, we'll run the one-off reapply and then unpause the backfill with the new patch.
kevin: dry-run output: 132 objects would need rewrap, no irreversible ops detected. planning to run rewrap in place and re-encrypt to current key.
jonathan: will also add telemetry to backfill to emit per-object KMS error codes so we can track regressions.
alice: added playbook entry and compliance note, linking to PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rbac-playbook/pull/47
maya: rolling patch to canary shard 7 now, will watch logs.
audit-bot: event: canary-backfill-start shard=7 job=452.canary user=maya ts=2167890345
jonathan: canary finished for 5k batch with 0 KMS failures, 5 transient db lock retries handled.
maya: reverting pause and scheduling full run after 30m. :thumbsup:
kevin: i'll follow-up to ensure key rotation process adds proper alias tags to prevent this in the future.
maya: closing thread — patch merged, backfill resumed with patched worker, monitoring green. final counts: 132 fixed in shard 7, audit logged. thanks all.
